SELECT lifecycle_reference_id, event_type, reference_type, vehicle_class, vehicle_condition, amount_value, rate_value, numeric_value, reference_year, reference_month, source_name, source_title, source_url, source_type, note, active, created_at, updated_at FROM lifecycle_reference WHERE event_type = #{eventType} AND reference_type = #{referenceType} AND vehicle_class = #{vehicleClass} AND active = TRUE
AND vehicle_condition = #{vehicleCondition}
AND vehicle_condition IS NULL
ORDER BY reference_year DESC, COALESCE(reference_month, 0) DESC, lifecycle_reference_id DESC LIMIT 1
